$comment: The public-surface gate's axes for @cosyte/hl7, read by cosyte-internal-refs (@cosyte/script-utils). Keys starting with $ are notes. The surface is what npm ships and docs.cosyte.com publishes: README.md, TRADEMARKS.md and LICENSE in the tarball, and every tracked file under docs-content/. package.json's description and keywords are scanned too. src/ doc comments compile into dist/*.d.ts, so they are scanned as well. CHANGELOG.md is accounted for, not scanned: it is where item identifiers belong. The standards designations are names a consumer of an HL7 toolkit must be able to read (HL7-V2, FHIR-R4, X12-837P); the extra samples are this repository's measured reference material, which a widened rule would destroy.

extraRules.$comment: The design-note ids this library's source comments once carried (a short upper-case code, a hyphen and a number), which the generated reference copied out of TSDoc. The positives below are samples of that shape, kept so the rule proves it still matches. The shared identifier rule matches only the project prefixes above, so it let them through. The negatives are the segment-field and code material the rule must never touch.
